An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/cohere-trial-keys $.free_tier.stated: The cited sign-up page (Continue with Google, Github, Email, Password) says nothing about trial-key call limits or per-minute rates, so it does not confirm free_tier.stated. The value itself is supported by docs.cohere.com/v2/docs/rate-limits (capture sha256:83e5955a...), which is not the page cited
- compute/cohere-trial-keys $.limits[0].value: The cited sign-up page says nothing about 1,000 calls a month or 20 req / min, so it does not confirm limits[0].value. The arithmetic (1,000 / 20 = 50 minutes) is correct against the rate-limits page (capture sha256:83e5955a...), which is not the page cited for this confirm.
- compute/inference-net $.free_tier.stated: The cited API-docs rate-limits page says nothing about the Pay as you go price, included gateway requests, tracing spans, retention, seats or the USD 50 opening credit, and it prints 1,000 RPM for Paid (Growth, Enterprise) where the claim states 250 req/min for Growth. The 250 req/min figure is on t
- compute/inference-net $.limits[0].value: The cited API-docs page gives Free 30 RPM (matches the 30 req/min) but 1,000 RPM for Growth against the claimed 250 req/min, and says nothing about seats or monthly credits. The pricing page (capture sha256:56d7dcb4...) does support the value, but it is not the page cited for this confirm.
- compute/z-ai-glm-flash $.limits[0].value: The cited pricing table says nothing about concurrency, queueing or the console rate-limits page, so it does not confirm limits[0].value. The value is supported by the concept-param page (capture sha256:2b849c49...), which is not the page cited for this confirm.
- compute/z-ai-glm-flash $.binding: The cited pricing table shows the three Flash models as Free and says nothing about a binding constraint or request rate. The only vendor page that mentions a limit, concept-param, describes concurrency, and the quantity is unpublished; the pricing page does not say binding is request-rate.
